summary: First MVP test of Matrix Energia 360 landing page. All backend and frontend tests passed successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Email sending via Resend is conditional on RESEND_API_KEY env var. If not set, emails are silently skipped - this is expected behavior but worth confirming RESEND_API_KEY is configured in production.
MongoDB _id is not excluded from contact_leads documents but since POST /api/contact doesn't return the stored document, this isn't an issue currently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working. Backend: POST /api/contact saves to MongoDB and returns success. Frontend: Hero, Header (sticky), FAQ accordion (expand/collapse), Contact form with all fields, form success state, footer email all verified. Color palette orange/black/white is correct.
